selectedPath: Capture original execution ownership per native purpose turn as an immutable accepted receipt, preserving one agent/context/work across turns.

Reuse execution/effect/tool machinery with that scope, including native process facts, administrative/workflow/cooperation tools, original-operation reconciliation, questions and Stop. Do not fabricate Connector.active or grant effects from metadata.

Actual ordinary human request -> Global creates agent/room through native tools -> useful peer work and cooperative editing -> scoped finding/correction -> reviewed artifact -> responder result. Commands/actions use the separate canonical execution activity domain.
Continue that same original work through reconnect/restart/compaction and targeted Stop, with unknown external effects retained.
Complete fresh-host/account/Git/SSH/admin readiness and NextComp phone operation; then two-human/two-host qualification and OZZZ product workflow.

currentExecutableSlice.scope: Per-turn execution ownership receipt and shared activity encoder/outbox; prerequisite to full tool restoration. No new semantic service/acceptance ledger.
currentExecutableSlice.why: The actual peer proof spans two native writer turns for one work. Existing native activity/effect paths treat a delivery as one native turn, and the purpose runtime does not invoke existing full native handlers.
currentExecutableSlice.acceptance: A finite real native task through human API emits attributable command/artifact activity separately from conversation. Preserve original scope in durable outbox and observe late immutable log receipts after the original turn closes; never replay execution.
currentExecutableSlice.notClaimed: This slice alone does not restore independent executor attestation, native effects, Global provisioning or full capability parity.

nextCoreSourceFindings.finding: Existing independent lifecycle capture assumes one delivery/executor and a connector service launcher. Purpose integration must preserve exact native process/service facts and allow original work to span successive native executions; do not fabricate delivery generations or bypass managed-service verification.

Tool declarations are insufficient: existing handlers depend on captured execution scope, role context, original-operation journals and partial administrative effect reconciliation. Reuse that complete path.

Current purpose installation captures a fixed role revision. Coherent role refresh and launcher/provisioning integration must retain identities, objectives and old operation receipts; current prototype is not a complete installation.

External goal admission suppresses autonomous goal chaining. Explicit turn/start still starts inference; it is not an independent native execution attestation or a prepare/commit API. Reuse pre-inference capture/attestation from the native lifecycle rather than infer authority from a post-start metadata receipt.
